Commentary.Commentary: Afghanistan are in a good position and they've shown they do have a good bowling attack, but questions arise as to whether Rashid Khan will come out and bowl. He was struggling quite a lot and was even unable to run towards the end while batting. For India, a good start will be important as the wicket is offering turn and will will also play slow as the game goes on. Join us on the other side of the break for the second half of this game.

Mohammad Shahzad, the star of the match, so far, gives a quick interview to Ramiz Raja. He starts by thanking the Almighty and says that he knows the conditions here quite well and is happy with his knock. Reckons that the conditions are demanding and he was focused on playing his natural game. Adds that everyday he comes with the intention to make it his day. Also mentions that he was aware of the changes made by India and his plan was to attack the new bowlers. States that there are world class spinners in his team and he is confident about the total.

It was a mixed bag for the Indian bowlers in terms of performance today. The pacers went for runs but the spinners did well. Jadeja, in particular, as he stood out with a 3-wicket haul. Kuldeep was economical and bagged 2 for himself in his first spell, but the rest couldn't produce a similar performance. What will sting them the most is the fact that after reducing the Afghans to 82/4, they couldn't capitalize on that and finish things off earlier.

A challenging score posted up on the board by Afghanistan after the slump in the middle overs. Electing to bat, Shahzad went crazy as he was middling the ball like it was nobody's business. Others fell around him after the end of Powerplay 1, as wickets were lost in clumps, but the opener kept on powering along. He later found allies from the lower middle order as he made two good stands with Naib and Nabi, eventually scoring a fine ton. Nabi carried on making a well-crafted fifty and some finishing touches towards the end from the rest saw Afghanistan crossing 250.
Short of a good length going across, Rashid just swings hoping to connect but can't manage to do that. So with that, AFGHANISTAN FINISH ON 252/8!
Rashid pulls it to deep mid-wicket but doesn't take the single as he's seen catching his hamstring again. Clearly struggling.

Safe! Just. Khan hits it towards long on and quickly calls for the second. The throw comes in from the deep at Dhoni's end and a direct hit is scored. Seems safe, but it's taken upstairs by the square leg umpire. Replays show Rashid is in by a narrow margin.
Direct hit. Has Rashid Khan made it back? Dhoni doesn't seem too confident.
Dot ball. Good bowling. Back of a length around off, Rashid can't put it away like he wants to on the off side.
Full outside off, driven to covers by Aftab Alam to rotate strike. And that brings the 250 up for Afghanistan.
Slower in pace on a back of a length, Khan backs away and lofts it towards long on as he runs to the other end.
Excellent over. Just 3 runs from it. Yorker wide outside off, Aftab Alam can't reach out to it and make connection.
Full again, attacking the stumps, whacked down the ground, but on the other side this time. Single taken.
Change of bat for Rashid Khan.
Drills the yorker down the ground to long off for an easy run.
Good bowling. Kaul gets the yorker spot on as he bowls this in line of the stumps, Alam just about manages to dig it out off the inner portion. Wants the run, but is rightly sent back by his partner.
Kaul spears a wide yorker outside off, Khan drills it square through point. Runs the first one hard, wants the second but won't get it as the fielder in the deep is quick to the ball.
Full delivery speared outside off, Rashid drills it to cover. Alam takes off but he sends him back. Wants to keep the strike.
Rashid Khan is seen getting some treatment from the physio. Some issue with his hamstring from the looks of it. Seems alright though to continue.
Length ball on leg, sliding down, catches Alam on the pads off the inside edge.
Alam has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller outside off, Rashid plays at it away from his body and it takes the edge. Dhoni dives to right but can't stop it. A single is taken.
Aftab Alam to bat next.

OUT! Good bowling brings an end to a very good knock from Mohammad Nabi. Khaleel continues from around the wicket and bowls a slower one full in length on the stumps. Nabi doesn't pick it up and ends up playing the lofted shot too early. Chips it in the extra cover region and two fielders converge to take this - Kuldeep from cover and Karthik from mid off. No calling whatsoever and the former takes it as they both collide. Could have just as easily dropped it, but nicely done eventually. The fielders exchange smiles. Good to see nobody got hurt either.
Swing and a miss from Nabi. Short of length around off, the slower one, Nabi swings too early and misses.
Angling back in from around off, on a good length, run down to third man for a run.
Khaleel Ahmed back on.
Fuller around off, Rashid looks to put bat on ball. Gets an inside edge onto his pads and the batsmen steal a single.
Quite full again, hit down to long on for a single.

Nabi drives it through the covers and takes off. Karthik gets to the ball, collects and tries to score a direct hit at the bowler's end. He misses and there's nobody backing up, so the batsmen take an extra run. Poor from the Indians. You expect much better standards from them.
On the shorter side of things, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Goes square this time. Places it through point and gets to the other end.

SIX! Right out of the screws, that one. Wow! What a phenomenal hit. Kaul goes full and attacks the stumps, Nabi throws his front leg out of the way, gets right under the ball and smokes it high into the night sky. Has the distance on it too as it sails deep into the mid-wicket stands.
Siddarth Kaul comes back on to have a go with the ball.

Turning back into the batsman from around off, it's forced off the back foot back towards the bowler. 3 off Kuldeep's last over, he finishes with figures of 10-0-38-2! He went for just 8 runs in his first 6 overs but took a pounding towards the death.
Spinning away from the batsman, again on the short side, Nabi hits it through cover-point for one.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Very full and outside off, driven firmly through the line but found the cover fielder inside the ring.
Full and flighted on middle, Khan is on the front foot as he defends it quietly on the off side.
Turning away from the batsman, it's on the shorter side and the batsman rocks back to slap it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out to end the over.
Driven well through the covers for an easy double. Rashid is off the mark.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Sharp turn for Jadeja. Lands it around off and it goes away, Khan tries to put bat on ball but gets beaten.
From around the wicket, it's full outside off, Rashid pushes it to covers off the front foot.
Rashid Khan strides out to bat.

OUT! A 3-fer for Jadeja! The on-field call stays. He comes from over the wicket and it spins in from around off, Zadran brings out the reverse sweep but fails to connect. Is caught around the hips but since he's got low to play, height isn't an issue. The appeal goes up and so does the finger. The southpaw reviews and replays show that he's dead plumb. Nothing saves him. A good stand though, was worth 46 off 38.
Review taken. Najibullah has been given leg before but he's challenged the decision here. Looks out to the naked eye. Let's see...
Quite full and extremely loopy outside off, drilled down to long off by Zadran for a run.
Yadav loops it right up there, on the stumps, it's played back to the bowler.
The batsman plays a sweep shot through backward square leg. They pick up a single.

12th ODI fifty for Mohammad Nabi! Off just 45 deliveries too. This has been superb work from him. Comes so low down the order but still gets the job done for his side. He gets low and sweeps it behind square leg for a couple.
Nabi sweeps it away on the leg side. Wants the single but is sent back.
Short and wide, Zadran rocks onto the back foot and cuts it square through point for one run.
FOUR! Moves to 49 with this. Excellent knock so far from Mohammad Nabi. He hangs back to this shorter delivery and punches it hard wide of sweeper cover to find the fence.
The southpaw stands tall and punches it just wide of the substitute Chahal at cover for a single.
Turning into the left-hander, Najibullah plays it with the spin and flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
It's again outside off, Zadran pushes it away towards cover-point. No run taken though.
Darts it quick and flat outside off, it's punched through the covers for a run.
Ravindra Jadeja is back again.
FOUR! 17 off the over. A super expensive one from Kuldeep. Zadran does well to get forward and across. Kneels down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Full ball attacking the stumps, swept in front of square on the leg side for one.

SIX! 12 off the over already. A big one for Afghanistan and it can become bigger with 2 balls to spare. Kuldeep loops it up outside off and Nabi doesn't hold anything back. Gives it the full swing of his bat and clears mid-wicket with absolute ease.
Outside off, Nabi fails to put bat on ball.

Najibullah with the reverse sweep and it's placed very well. Behind square on the off side and once again the batsmen run hard. They see the third run is on and complete it again. Superb. The 200 is up for Afghanistan.

Nabi does well here. Gets low fast seeing the ball tossed up and sweeps it fine down the leg side, getting it past Dhoni. Both batsmen run hard and manage to take the third one as well. Good running between the wickets.
Kuldeep Yadav continues from this end.
Switches the angle for Zadran and pitches it around off on a length, defended down on the off side to end the over.
Cutting back in, worked into the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Around the wicket again and it's a boundary. Khaleel bowls it full on off, it's angling in but Nabi is well on top of this one. Stays right behind the line and drives it ever so well through the gap in the covers for a boundary.
Over the wicket to Najibullah, outside off and the southpaw works it to third man for one more.
Moves a step across and gets inside the line of this short delivery, before pulling it along the ground in front of square leg for a single.
From around the wicket, it's a length ball outside off, Nabi with an open face pushes it to point.
Powerplay 3 signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Slower in pace, a googly. It spins away after landing around off and Zadran is beaten on his forward defensive prod.
Flighted and on off, defended off the front foot.

FOUR! Misfield! Poor by Khaleel there. But a fine shot by Zadran. He brings out the reverse sweep and goes with the spin. Gets it from the middle of the bat and it races towards short third man where Khaleel makes a complete mess. Afghanistan won't mind this at all.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it behind square leg for a run.
Tossed up ball on off, fuller in length, Nabi lunges and defends.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. Loopy and full landing outside off. It spins back in as the batsman tries to sweep. Misses to get hit on the pads, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Impact clearly outside off.
Kuldeep Yadav is brought back into the attack. He has two wickets in the 6 overs bowled, so far.
Forces it on the off side for a single.
Outside off, on a length once again, chopped away from inside the crease through point. A couple of runs taken.
Seaming back in from a good length, Nabi works it away towards the empty square leg area and takes one.
Cut late down to third man and Najibullah is off the mark with a run.
Similar ball, similar shot, to the same fielder. Dot ball.
Good length delivery close to off, Najibullah runs it down to short third man with a slightly open face.
Khaleel Ahmed is back on.
Shortish and on middle, played off the pads towards square. A successful over for India comes to an end.
Najibullah Zadran walks in next.

OUT! Shahzad holes out! The fun is over. But what a great knock by the wicketkeeper batsman. He walks back to a standing ovation from his teammates. Coming to the delivery, Jadhav probably senses the charge from the batsman. Hence, he serves it full and wide outside off.  MS is down the track looking for a big shot but it's too wide of him and he has to reach out for it. As a result, it flies off the bottom half of the bat and Karthik moves across to his right from long off to catch the skier safely. The 48-run stand is over as well and the timing of this wicket will hurt Afghanistan.
Fires it down the leg side, Shahzad moves back and attempts a big reverse heave. Connects but finds the cover fielder.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched down towards long on for a run.
Shortish and on middle, played from the back foot to mid-wicket.
Goes inside-out to a full ball and lofts it over covers for a run.
Nabi has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The ball is lost. Nabi hit that at the sightscreen and it just went under it somewhere after that. So, the umpire has called for a replacement.
SIX! High and handsome! This one is served right in the slot for the batsman. Full and around off, Nabi attacks it with all his might and sends it packing over the bowler's head for a maximum.

Direct hit would have been curtains for Shahzad! Shortish delivery outside off, MS goes hard at it as he tries to slap it square of the wicket on the off side. But it catches the bottom edge of the bat and rolls to short third man. His partner is interested in a run, Shahzad also is outside the crease but is ball-watching. Meanwhile, Jadhav has a shy at the striker's end but misses. The ball now travels to long on and an overthrow results.
Nabi opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full again, in line of the stumps, Nabi forces it down the ground but finds mid on.
Fullish and outside off, stroked through covers for one.
Flatter and on middle, punched down to long on for a run.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and punches it back to the bowler.
Jadhav sees the batsman making room by moving down the leg side and follows. Shahzad still attempts to play a square cut but misses.
Quicker this time, it's fired on middle, Shahzad once again steps back and then goes for the slog sweep. Connects nicely as well but finds the mid-wicket fielder inside the ring.

FOUR! Takes a calculative risk and fetches a boundary. Flatter and fuller outside off, Shahzad steps back to make room and rockets it inside-out over cover-point. It's wide of the sweeper cover fielder and crosses the fence.
Edged but safe! Full and around off, Nabi skips down the track to heave it over the leg side but it takes the outside edge and flies towards short third man. A single taken.
Good length delivery outside off, Nabi pushes inside the line and gets it away off the outside half of the bat to third man. A single to end a 9-run over.

SIX! That has gone all the way! Kaul digs in a short ball and angles it into the batsman, Nabi shimmies down the track a bit and pulls it clinically over mid-wicket. There is a fielder in the deep but he can do nothing about it as the ball flies to his left.
Eyes a yorker but ends up slipping in a low full toss. Shahzad moves back inside the crease and hits it out through mid-wicket for a run.
A length ball angling into the batsman from around off, Nabi pushes it from the crease and manages to get it past the left side of the cover fielder. A run is taken.
Slower in pace and shorter in length, around off, Nabi picks it up and tries to play it late to find the gap on the off side. Although he ends up pushing it straight to the cover fielder.
Bouncer around off, Nabi sways away from the line.

Drinks are on the field. India continue to remain on top in this encounter, however, Afghanistan have fared a lot better than they were at the last drinks break. Mohammad Shahzad is going strong. He has completed his century and now holds the key. Afghanistan would hope that he lasts the distance and the lower order rallies around him.
Shortish and Nabi moves across and works it towards square leg for one.

FOUR! Excellent shot! The length is a bit too full this time by Jadhav and Nabi goes down on one knee to play the sweep shot. Gets it away from the middle of his blade and sends it whistling to the backward square leg fence.
Loopy and on middle, helped with the spin to mid-wicket. Straight to the fielder this time.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Goes on the back foot to a shortish ball and punches it towards cover-point.
Tossed up ball on middle, pushed to the left of mid-wicket.

A bit of a comical attempt, this. Kaul serves a full toss outside off, Shahzad walks across the stumps to play a cute paddle shot but gets into an awkward position and only manages to push it as far as the short fine leg fielder. Completely off balance.
A half-volley outside off, Shahzad keeps his weight on the back leg and hammers it down the ground. Finds mid off though.
Well bowled. A wide yorker outside off, Shahzad tries to dig it out but is beaten for pace.
Short in length and on off, not enough pace to hurry up the batsman, Nabi easily gets on top of the bounce and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, slower in pace and cutting back in, Nabi remains back and taps it down to point.
Digs in a short delivery outside off, Shahzad stands back and cuts it in front of square on the off side. The ball races away to the deep and they take a single.
Wide! A gentle loosener to begin a fresh spell. Hurls it on a length way wide outside off. Shahzad allows it through.
Siddarth Kaul back on.
Another punch, down the ground to long off this time. Another run results.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Smacks this one square towards point but finds the fielder there.
Good stop by Jadeja. Nabi forces it towards mid on off the back foot but the all-rounder moves swiftly to his left from short mid-wicket and cuts it off.
On middle and leg this time, Nabi tries to sweep but wears it on the pads. It was going down leg, so no real appeal made for leg before.
Jadhav throws it full and wide outside off, Nabi hits it to the cover fielder.
Bumper on middle and leg, no shot offered.
That's stung clearly. Shahzad misses the big pull as Chahar takes some of the pace off it. The ball raps him on the hips and he quickly walks away rubbing that same area.
Nabi tickles it fine as he gets one on the pads. One more run to the scoreboard.
Through the mid-wicket region again, but just a single comes off it.
Hits the deck hard and bowls a bouncer, on leg, Shahzad somehow manages to steer clear of the ball.

SIX! Right in the slot and he puts it away too. What a hit. Full ball on middle and leg, Shahzad walks a step across and whips it over mid-wicket. Gets right under the ball and deposits it over the cow corner for half a dozen.
Drives this full ball down to long on and hobbles to the other end.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Flatter and shorter, defended off the back foot. Shahzad seems to be struggling a bit, might have a cramp on his hamstring.
Spinning in a bit, swept away on the leg side for a run.
A punch from Shahzad off the back foot to long on earns him a single.
Short ball angling in, Shahzad backs away and punches it towards short mid-wicket, where Jadeja does well to stop the ball.
Kedar Jadhav is back.
Slower bouncer, Nabi doesn't pick it up at all. Ducks too early as the ball goes above his head. Has a laugh afterwards.
Too straight in line, flicked through mid-wicket along the carpet for a single.
Mohammad Nabi is the new batsman.

OUT! He's gone! A budding partnership for Afghanistan comes to an end. Chahar gets his first wicket in ODI cricket. Full and coming in on the pads, Naib flicks it over mid-wicket. No elevation on it and the placement is so good that Gulbadin finds Jadhav out in the deep. He moves a couple of steps to his right and takes it safely. The growing stand is broken and India continue to be on top.
A hint of shape away, fuller length delivery around off, blocked with no trouble at all.
Sprays it on leg stump, raps Shahzad on the pads as he tries to flick it away. It rolls away on the leg side and a leg bye is taken. The 50-run stand comes up with this.

FOUR! 5th ODI ton for Mohammad Shahzad! Well-deserved for the big man. Thoroughly deserves it. And you can see just how much it means to him too, he's really pumped. He's excelled when all the other batsmen have failed. Superb batting. It's a freebie really. He gets it on the pads and tickles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Deepak Chahar returns to the attack. He was expensive as he went for 24 runs in his first two overs. Probably nerves getting to him. Let's see if he can put in a better show in this second spell.
Short of a good length outside off, Naib rises on his toes, gets on top of the bounce and offers a solid punch to cover-point.
Bowls a good length delivery on off, guarded from the inner half on the leg side.
Brings out the short one again and almost takes the batsman by surprise. Gulbadin at the last moment ducks and evades. The umpire signals second for the over.
Shaping back in off the seam, a little fuller in length, it's blocked tamely on the leg side.
Comfortably done. Shahzad opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man before getting to the other end.
Begins things with a bouncer outside off, the batsman doesn't bother himself with it. The umpire signals one for the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Taps this shorter ball in front of cover and hares to the other end to complete the run. A rare sight, that. Just goes to show how badly he wants that hundred.
Shahzad makes use of the feet and dabs it to short third man. Thinks of taking the single but then opts out of it.
Worked away with the wrists into the leg side and a run is taken.
Shorter again, another defensive shot presented by Gulbadin Naib.
Flatter ball on middle and off, turning away a touch, Naib is on the back foot to keep it out.
Goes for the yorker and almost executes it. It's quite full and Gulbadin flicks it well in front of square on the leg side. A single is collected.
In the channel around off, tapped down right beside him on the off side.
Cutting in from a good length, close to off, Naib blocks it off the inner half to the right of the bowler.

FOUR! Top edge and away! Bumper angling in on leg, hurries Naib into the pull shot and he gets a top edge as a result. The ball runs down to fine leg and a boundary results. Well, what do you know? This is the first boundary of the innings which hasn't been scored by Mohammad Shahzad. Unreal stuff.
Fraction straight in line, easily worked away in front of square leg for a double.
Muted appeal for a leg before, but even Kaul opts out of it quickly. Back of a length on off, raps the batsman high on the thigh pad as he tries to play at it.
Siddarth Kaul back on.
A little sloppy from Jaddu, a rare instance for him. Naib drives it back to him but he's slow to get down and lets it through him. One run to end the over.
Jadeja keeps it short again, Naib presents a defensive bat in response.
Goes back and whips this flat ball towards wide long on for one more.
Jadeja bowls it full and slows it through the air around off, it turns away and takes the outside edge of Naib's bat who is forward to block. Rolls towards third man and a single is taken.
Short ball, Naib decides to block it again.
Drifting in on off stump, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Drags his length a bit and bowls it on off, Shahzad moves back and defends it towards the bowler. Watchful.
Floated and full outside off, tuning back in a bit, Shahzad reaches out for it and pushes it of the inside half of his bat to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on middle, Naib kneels and slog sweeps it in front of square leg for a run.
Walks forward to a full ball and pushes it back to Kuldeep.
Spinning into the batsman this time, Gulbadin flicks it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
Beaten! Full and around middle, turning away, Naib lunges in defense and is beaten by the away spin.

Slower than the last delivery. A touch short and outside off, Naib plays inside the line and edges it down towards deep backward point. The third man fielder moves across to his right to stop the ball and they cross for a run.
A 139 kph delivery, angling into the batsman on a good length, Naib sticks back and pushes it towards the bowler.
Slants in a good length ball on off, Naib jumps on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Angles in a shortish ball on middle, Shahzad gets on top of the delivery and works it in front of square leg for a run.
Sensibly left this time. Back of a length delivery outside off, MS stays inside the crease and shoulders arms.
A mishit! Short and outside off, from 'round the wicket, Shahzad gets across the stumps, swings his bat but fails to middle his shot again. It goes behind after taking the bottom edge of his bat.
A dot to end, 5 in a row! Just a single from the over as Yadav bowls a loopy ball on middle, Naib blocks it out.
Sharp turn there! Another ball tossed up outside off, it comes back in with a lot of bite. Naib goes back and tries to keep it out but is hit high on the pads.

Another tossed up delivery, it pitches and turns back in sharply. Naib lunges and tries to defend but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket. Now then, a short leg place could come handy with the amount of turn which is on offer out there.
Slower through the air on the pads, Naib works it to mid-wicket.
The leggie on middle, Naib gets behind the line and defends it onto the ground.
The googly on off, Shahzad drops it towards covers for a quick run. 5 short from a ton now is the opener.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Naib defends it off his back foot towards the bowler. End of an eventful over, 7 coming from it.
Full and on off, Naib is on the front foot in defense.
Width on offer outside off, MS calmly runs it down to third man for a run.

NOT OUT! Brilliant use of the technology by Shahzad. Ahmed comes running in from 'round the wicket and bangs in a short ball around off. Shahzad tries to pull it across the line but loses his posture a bit. Fails to get it off the meat of the bat and there is some noise as it goes behind. Dhoni collects the ball, they all appeal and the finger goes up. Shahzad indicates to his partner that it has brushed his sleeves and then goes for the DRS. The replays confirm the same.
Mohammad Shahzad is given out caught behind. He moves away, has a chat with his partner and goes for the DRS. There was some noise. Not sure off what though...
Play and a miss! Short and angling away from the batsman, Shahzad goes back to play the square cut but fails to make any connection.
SIX! Nails it! Pace on the ball and Shahzad loves it. He rocks back and across to a length ball and launches it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Welcome into the attack, Khaleel.
Khaleel Ahmed is back into the attack.

Just out of the reach of the short cover fielder, Karthik. Spinning away from the batsman after landing full, Naib swings his bat  but gets a leading edge on it. It loops in the air, Karthik moves back a bit and then puts in a dive but it falls just safely. Heart in mouth stuff for Gulbadin.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Straighter in line this time, it's eased with the spin on the leg side. Finds the gap and a run is taken.
Watchful now, maybe wants to get to his hundred without taking any unnecessary chances. Loopy and on off, Shahzad draws forward in defense and gets it away off the inside half of his bat.
Full and outside off, pushed out with the turn to covers.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot by Shahzad.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Quicker and flatter outside off, Shahzad tries to sweep but misses.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Appeal for an lbw! Shahzad goes down and across to play the paddle sweep but fails to connect. He is hit on the pads, they let out a stifled appeal but nothing doing.

SIX! Bang! This is even better. Jadeja allows the batsman to get under this delivery and smoke it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Massive effort this by MS, has scored 85 runs out of the 99 put on the board.
FOUR! Shahzad is not bothered at all. Receives a full toss and muscles it over short fine leg for a boundary. Fine connection.
Full and turning back in, Naib flicks it on the leg side but finds square leg.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy and on off, Naib works it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Loopy and full outside off, Shahzad attacks it and powers it over mid on. Doesn't carry to the fielder in the deep as he collects it on one bounce. A single taken.
Tossed up ball on leg, it's punched off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Floated and on off, Shahzad goes down on one knee and swings it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Wide! Jadeja bowls it wide outside off, Shahzad lets it be.
Full and on middle, Naib strides forward and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Naib has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Short again, outside off, Shahzad this time cracks it off his back foot to deep cover. They come back for the second run as Chahal, the substitute fielder, sends in the throw towards the keeper's end. Dhoni collects and deflects it onto the stumps without looking behind. No harm done.
Flatter and shorter outside off, cut from the back foot but straight to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. End of a tremendous over by Kuldeep, 2 wickets and a run from it.
Very full again, on off, Naib tries to drive but gets it away off the inside half of the bat. It rolls towards square leg and the leg gully fielder moves across to his left to pick it up.
No hat-trick. Full and flighted, landing around off, Naib leans forward in defense. Watchfully negotiated.
Gulbadin Naib is the next batsman in. Wickets falling faster than the Flash here. Two slips and two leg gullys in place for Naib. Dhoni really attacking now.

OUT! Bowled 'em! KULDEEP ON A HAT-TRICK! He dishes out his stock ball again which lands around off and turns back in. Afghan comes forward to this initially looking to drive but then decides to play it from the back foot. His attempt is to flick but misses the ball completely. The ball is not missing the sticks. The Indians are ecstatic as Afghan with a bamboozled look walks back.

Drinks break. Afghanistan started the innings off well with Shahzad firing away like there's no tomorrow, but some quick wickets after the end of Powerplay 1 saw India come back in this match well. Will be interesting to see if Afghanistan can shore things up now. Also, Asghar Afghan, the skipper, walks into the middle next.

OUT! Superb stumping by MS Dhoni. He is lightning quick as we all know and he just proves it again. 00.16 seconds and the bails are off. Wow! Really a master of quick reflexes. We have to give credit to Kuldeep here as well. It's beautifully tossed up in the air and Shahidi is lured into the shot. He shimmies down the track but then quickly realizes that he's beaten in the flight. Tries to defend after that but it turns away to beat his bat. Hashmatullah tries to get back in but Dhoni is ultra-quick in collecting the ball and removing the bails. The square leg umpire has his finger raised and Afghanistan have suddenly hit a roadblock, they have lost three wickets in 17 balls.
Full and flighted on off, it's driven with the spin through extra cover for a run.
Kuldeep Yadav is into the attack.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot to end the over.
Shahidi has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Hashmatullah Shahidi walks in next.

OUT! Jadeja bowls a beauty to get rid of Rahmat Shah. Second wicket for him and he has struck in consecutive overs to provide India some relief. He tosses it up in the air and lands it around middle. Shah is forward to defend, probably, playing for the away spin but to his bad luck, it turns out to be an arm ball. It kisses the deck, beats his bat and sneaks past his pads to disturb the sticks. One of Afghanistan's premier batsmen departs cheaply.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Thrashed! As soon as Jadeja drops it short, Shahzad goes deep inside the crease and cracks it via a pull shot to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Full and around off, Rahmat leans forward and drives it down through mid off for a run.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it towards covers. 8 coming from this over.

Uppish, just short of the fielder! Jadhav bowls it short and wide outside off, Shahzad slaps it through the line, it's aerial but drops just in front of Rayudu at covers. It hits his hands after that and rolls towards the bowler. Shahzad is living dangerously all his innings and has been lucky too.
SIX! BANG! That's outta here. A little bit of air and Shahzad pummels this. In his slot as he clears his front leg and smokes it straight back over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Gives the charge as it's darted wide outside off, drills it through the gap in the covers and takes two for doing so.
Quicker and shorter outside off, hit straight to the covers.
Quicker and flatter on off, Shahzad goes back and smacks it back to the bowler.
Drags his length short and outside off, Shah outside edges his attempted square cut past the slip fielder for a brace. End of a successful over for Jadeja.
Loopy and full on off, defended off the front foot.
Rahmat Shah is in next at number 3.

OUT! MS Dhoni is rarely wrong. Ahmadi has to depart. He contributed just 5 runs in the 65-run opening stand. But credit to him for hanging in with Shahzad. Coming to the wicket, Jadeja serves it full and on middle, Ahmadi runs down the track to play a big shot probably but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects behind to Dhoni, who collects it and does the rest with ease. He appeals before going to celebrate with his players and the square leg umpire signals for the third umpire. The replays roll in and they show that Ahmadi is way outside his crease. First success for India.
Appeal for a stumping! MS Dhoni is quite sure but the square leg umpire wants to get it referred upstairs. Let's wait and watch...
Turn and bounce. Beaten. Ahmadi rocks back to play the square cut but is beaten. Wasn't far away from the outside edge.
Turning away a bit from around off, Ahmadi blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Ravindra Jadeja returns. Change of ends for him. He has a slip in place.
Flighted and on middle, Shahzad clips it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
This time Ahmadi finds the gap with his flick shot and pushes it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up ball on middle, worked off the pads but straight towards square leg.
Gets forward to a full ball and drives it through the line, finds the cover fielder.
Slightly short and around off, Ahmadi goes on the back foot and pushes it out on the off side.
Flighted delivery to start with, full and on off, Ahmadi defends it back.
Kedar Jadhav brought into the bowling attack.
Whoa! Big swing and a big miss from Shahzad. Doesn't pick up the googly as Kuldeep throws it outside off, gets low to slog it over mid-wicket but is beaten all ends up.
Spinning away from around off, played to point for no run.
A lot of air around off, Mohammad Shahzad moves across the sticks, before patting it back down towards Kuldeep.
Straighter one but on the pads, swept well through to deep backward square leg for a single.
Kuldeep bowls this really slow through the air again, Ahmadi comes forward and blocks once more.
A lot of loop on this, around off, Ahmadi is well forward in defense.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. A maximum of 4 fielders are allowed outside the ring till the end of the 40th over. Also, Kuldeep Yadav to roll his arm over now.
A touch slower through the air, turning away from outside off, Shahzad shoulders his arms to it.
Looks to play this away but can't connect with the ball. Gets it off the inside half on the leg side.
Another dot. Jadeja coming back well here. This full delivery is drilled to mid off.
Full in line of the stumps, drilled to mid on.
Seeing Shahzad make room, Jadeja fires it on his pads. The batsman still manages to force it away to the covers.

SIX! Sweet, sweet connection off the middle. Shahzad doesn't care who comes at him, he's just murdering everything that's coming his way. Gets low to this tossed up delivery and slogs it high and handsome over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.
Works it away on the leg side to end the over.

Dropped! What a grave mistake from Ambati Rayudu. With the kind of form Shahzad is in, no way he should have let that slip. An easy catch too. Shahzad powers this full ball aerially towards mid off. Rayudu moves to his right, gets his hands to it but drops it. A single is taken and that's the fifty up for Shahzad. His 14th in this format. Well-deserved too.
Fired in full, on middle stump, brings his bat in front of his pad to defend.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for the attacking opener. Moves to 49 with that. It's full and wide outside off, Shahzad hammers it with a lot of power over the covers to find the fence.
FOUR! That made a cracking sound as the ball went off the bat. Short ball and Shahzad picks it up early. Stands tall and muscles the pull over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length delivery just outside the line of off stump, punched square to point.
Siddarth Kaul is back on. Change of ends for him.
Better. Is watchful as he stays right behind the line of this one and blocks.
Spinning away from around off, Ahmadi goes back to cut when there isn't much room and could have paid the price. Misses and is lucky he doesn't chop it back on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bit quicker through the air on off, Javed defends it down behind in front of the slip fielder.

Beaten! This is brilliant bowling. Sharp turn for Jadeja from the get-go. Loops it up from around the wicket on off and it just rips off the deck. Ahmadi is forward to defend but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Full and around off, driven to mid off.
Ravindra Jadeja into the attack now. Spin introduced early on from Dhoni, good move. Shahzad was attacking the pacers. Maybe some spin can do the trick.
Good comeback from Khaleel. Six off the first and just 2 runs conceded in the entire over after that. Pounds it short and Shahzad fails to connect with the pull.
Shaping away from a good length around off, punched firmly past point. Jadeja chases after it and throws it back in, restricting the batsmen to a couple of runs.
That's the length to bowl to Shahzad. Keep it short and close to the body. Ahmed bangs it in on the leg stump line and the batsman can only awkwardly duck and evade it.
Around the off stump again, once again the opener fails to put bat on ball.
Shortish delivery around off, going away, the batsman goes for the pull shot but misses.

SIX! Big shot from the big man! They're playing to his strengths for now. This time, Ahmed fires it full around off, Shahzad stays firm in the crease and clears the long on fence with a mighty swing of his bat. Khaleel concedes a boundary after 9 balls, been bowling well so far. Hit for a big one first up, can he come back well?

Shahzad plays this very late. Waits for the length ball to come and cuts it down off the outer half to third man at the last minute. Ahmed out in the deep moves to his left and keeps the batsmen to just the one.
Hurled on a length on off, played back in the bowler's direction.
Angling in on middle and leg, worked defensively towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! Finds the gap this time. A boundary after 8 dot balls. The pressure was mounting and this will certainly help. That's a good shot. Kaul offers too much room outside off, Shahzad can free his arms and he does so. Cracks it through extra cover and sends it across the boundary line.
Full in length again, outside the line of off stump, drilled right at the cover fielder.
Full ball well outside off, driven hard square of the wicket on the off side but can't find the gap.
Siddarth Kaul into the attack now.
Maiden over from Khaleel Ahmed. Finishes well. Keeps it tight around that off stump channel and on a length, Javed pats it away to the point fielder.

Good work from Rahul, doesn't let it pass. Ahmadi once again waits for the ball to guide it to third man, but the placement is a bit too fine and KL at wide first slip moves swiftly to his right and stops the ball with a dive. Nicely done.
Tries running this down to third man but doesn't get the placement right. Instead, plays it straight to point again.
Just ahead of a length, Ahmadi dabs it to point.
Stays deep inside the crease to this shortish ball and presents a defensive shot in response.
Short of a length delivery on off, Ahmadi hops and blocks it solidly with a straight blade.

FOUR! 17 runs off this over. Not exactly the ideal start for Deepak Chahar's ODI career. He pitches this short and on off, Shahzad takes a step across to move inside the line and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller ball is driven to mid on for no run.
SIX! Keeps it full and straight this time and Shahzad dispatches that. Was ready for it. Cleared his front leg and slogged it well over the cow corner for the first maximum of the innings.
Wide! Probably nerves? Perhaps trying a bit too hard. Short and way outside off, it's too high and goes across the tramline too. Wide called. Free Hit still there...

Wide! Tries a slower bouncer this time but it doesn't come off well. Goes way over Mohammad Shahzad's head who attempts to club it over the leg side. The Free Hit will carry forward to the next delivery.

No ball! It's a beamer and that'll be a Free Hit. Chahar was attempting the back-of-the-hand slower one but it just slips out of his hands, Shahzad ducks and evades. Gives a big stare to the bowler who just turns around and goes back to his mark. MS Dhoni is seen having a chat with the square leg umpire, seems a warning has been issued for Chahar.
Full in length, on the sixth stump line, played off the outer half behind point for a comfortable single.
First runs for Javed Ahmadi. He whips this length delivery aerially through square leg and seeing the big gap out there, he decides to come back for the second.
No movement on this occasion for Chahar. He bowls it fuller on middle and leg, Shahzad picks it off his pads and nudges it square on the leg side for a run.
Short ball banged in, in line of the stumps, Ahmadi moves inside the line and awkwardly works it down in front of short mid-wicket.
Tight line. Cramping Ahmadi for room by bowling it around off and making it come back in. The batsman can only defend it under his nose.
Back of a length ball around off, a firm punch is offered straight to the man at cover.
The natural angle away from the right-hander, he opens the bat face and runs it down to third man for a single.
Oooofff! That wasn't far away. Khaleel serves it on a length and it holds its line. Shahzad leaves and it goes agonizingly close past the off stick. Too close for comfort.
FOUR! Full and right in the slot, Mohammad Shahzad has no second thoughts about putting this away. With a nice extension of the arms he lifts it over mid on and sends it across the boundary line.
Finds the gap well. Shahzad flicks this neatly through the mid-wicket region and takes three. Was a fraction straight in line, played that well. 7 from Chahar's first over in ODIs.
Fullish in length in that off stump channel, presents a straight blade in response to keep it out.
FOUR! This is how he bats. There's enough room with the swing away from him. Walks down the track and lofts it over cover-point to find the fence. Nicely played, Shahzad.
Hits that good length and targets the top of off stump, it's blocked well with the full face of the bat.
Brings it back in this time, keeps it full again. Shahzad is half-forward this time as he plays it back down the track.
A bit of shape away as he lands it outside off, fuller in length. Shahzad plants his front foot forward and raises his bat to let it be.
The debutant Deepak Chahar to bowl from the other end with the second new ball. Let's see how he fares in his first outing in the Indian blue.
Retains strike with a single. Mohammad Shahzad pulls this down to fine leg and easily gets to the other end. Decent first over from Ahmed.
Shaping away from around off, on a good length, dabbed to backward point with an open face.
On the hips, worked gently on the leg side. No run taken.

FOUR! Did not intend to do that at all. Shahzad actually wanted to leave this shortish ball, but was a little late in doing so and as a result, the ball went off the top half of the bat and over the gap between the keeper and first slip for a boundary.
Wide! Ahmed errs in line as he sprays it down the leg side, the batsman looks to flick but misses.
Just behind a length, keeps it around off again, Shahzad from inside the crease pushes it on the off side.
Good length delivery cutting in from around off, Shahzad rises on his toes and and blocks it back down the track.

We are ready to begin. Mohammad Shahzad has a new partner in Javed Ahmadi today. India spread out across the field after a last-minute pep talk from a familiar man. Khaleel Ahmed to kick things off. A slip in place along with a gully. Here we go...
Out come the match officials, referee and players from both teams for the national anthems. Afghanistan's first followed by India's.

New (stand-in) India captain, MS Dhoni says they were looking to bowl first anyway. On team changes, informs both openers (Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan) are missing, along with Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Jasprit Bumrah and Yuzvendra Chahal. Reckons it's a good opportunity for the others to get a chance. Adds that even if they haven't got a chance yet, they are a part of the squad and there's no doubt about their quality. Adds further it's important for them to adjust to the conditions and do well. On his 200th ODI as captain, he says it's good to get to the milestone but it doesn't really matter to him.

Regular Afghanistan captain, Asghar Afghan says the wicket looks good for the spinners so wants to put runs on the board first up. Mentions there are two changes as Samiullah Shenwari and Ihsanullah Janat go out for Najibullah Zadran and Javed Ahmadi. States in the last two games they played very well and have learnt a lot of lessons from them. Feels conditions aren't all that different from Abu Dhabi as they play in the UAE quite regularly.
TOSS - Afghanistan win the toss and opt to bat!
Pitch report - It's not so hot today, a bit windy. The pitch looks a batting beauty and the bowlers might get something out of it if they hit the right lengths.

Hello and a very warm welcome everyone for the clash between arguably the two best teams in the tournament. Both topped their group in the preliminary stage, although have experienced different fortunes after that. With a couple of crushing wins, India have stormed into the final while Afghanistan suffered back-to-back close losses to get knocked out. The stakes aren't too high in this dead-rubber but watching the Afghans' recent resurgence, you can expect them to present a tough fight. For the Men in Blue, it will be an opportunity to check their bench strength and also the form of their middle order batsmen, who so far have got very little time in the middle. Let's hope for another thriller.
